Bright hello new starters,
At first light changed little, but water bowls stayed in focus

Please treat this as a safety review note for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. Our checks remain brisk: carriers must be secure, labels clear, and handoffs calm. <<FACT F118>> Any gap in reporting should go to the senior coordinator at once, with the ground team informed before the next transfer.

Escapes in transit are handled by the same steady review path. <<FACT F114>> Please confirm carrier latches, bedding condition, and stress signs before release, and keep the record plain. If a pet shows distress, pause the move and escalate without delay.

Thank you for keeping standards firm and movements orderly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
